title: Attribute
description: NGSI-LD Attribute data type (ETSI GS CIM 009 clause 5.2.28). Used as an element of EntityTypeInfo.attributeDetails (clause 4.5.12), in the detailed attribute list from GET /attributes?details=true (clause 4.5.14), and as the attribute information from GET /attributes/{attrId} (clause 4.5.15). Not subject to options=concise/keyValues.

id.description: Full URI of the attribute name.

type.description: JSON-LD @type. It shall be equal to "Attribute".

attributeName.description: Name of the attribute; short name if contained in @context.

attributeCount.description: Number of attribute instances with this attribute name. Cardinality 0..1.

attributeTypes.description: List of attribute types (e.g. Property, Relationship, GeoProperty) for which entity instances containing an attribute with this name exist. Cardinality 0..1.

typeNames.description: List of entity type names for which entity instances exist containing an attribute with this name. Cardinality 0..1.
